$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. ReconnectToken: named but never specified in the source pack — designed here per the WP-1 task brief's explicit instruction. Used by a WorkspaceProvider (SSH/SAF-backed most concretely) to resume a connection from AUTH_REQUIRED or DISCONNECTED (WorkspaceProviderState, WORKSPACE_KERNEL_SPEC.md §6) without a full re-authentication round trip, while the token is still within its validity window. `tokenBytes` is OPAQUE — this schema cannot and does not attempt to verify it is not accidentally plaintext credential material; binding rule 5 (API keys encrypted at rest, never logged) applies to it exactly as to any other secret (see fixtures/workspace/adversarial/reconnect-token-plaintext-secret-leak.adversarial.json).
title: ReconnectToken

providerId.description: The `Workspace.providerConnections[].providerId` this token is scoped to. A ReconnectToken issued for one provider connection MUST NOT be accepted to reconnect a different one.

tokenBytes.description: Opaque, provider-issued reconnection credential, base64/base64url-encoded. MUST be treated as a secret for storage (Android Keystore, per binding rule 5) and logging (never logged) purposes identical to an API key — this field's opacity is a naming convention, not something JSON Schema can verify (a producer could still populate it with recognizable plaintext; see the adversarial fixture).

issuedAtUtc.description: UTC instant this token was issued (FB-RAT-COM-004).

expiresAtUtc.description: UTC instant after which this token MUST NOT be accepted for reconnection. MUST be later than `issuedAtUtc` — not structurally enforced here (JSON Schema 2020-12 has no cross-property date comparison keyword without a `$data` extension this constellation does not depend on); a reader MUST treat expiresAtUtc <= issuedAtUtc as malformed.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).
